methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen pole saws spanning corded electric, battery/cordless, and gas 2-stroke designs, verified 2026-08-05 against manufacturer product pages (DeWalt, Milwaukee, Husqvarna, Stihl, Makita, Worx, EGO) and their own hosted manuals/spec sheets, corroborated by major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Ace Hardware, Amazon, Walmart, AutoZone, Toolstash); two adversarial corrections were made to the seed list: (1) "EGO Power+ PSAX1000" does not exist as a product code — EGO's actual 10 in. pole saw attachment for the Multi-Head/Power Head system is the PSA1000 (no "X"), so the seed was replaced with PSA1000, confirmed on EGO's own operator's manual and Amazon/Lowe's listings; (2) "Ryobi RY40563" does not correspond to any Ryobi product — the closest and current real model is the RY40561 40V Attachment-Capable 10 in. Pole Saw (Expand-It compatible), which the seed was replaced with. Fields left null (chain speed, oil tank capacity, max cutting diameter, chain pitch, or weight on several entries) reflect specs genuinely absent from every manufacturer/retailer page fetched — null was used rather than inferring by analogy to similar models. Prices are the clearest current retail or MSRP figure found; where a brand restricts online price display or sells only through dealers (Stihl bare tool, Husqvarna dealer network), priceNote records the sourced dealer/retail figure actually seen. accessedAt 2026-08-05 throughout.

products.name: EGO Power+ PSA1000 10 in. Pole Saw Attachment (Multi-Head System)
products.priceNote: Richardson Saw current retail; Walmart lists the same attachment at $220.89. Attachment only — EGO Power Head (PH1400/PH1420), battery, and charger sold separately.

specs.powerSource: 56V ARC Lithium-ion (attachment for EGO Power Head PH1400/PH1420; battery not included)

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model code "PSAX1000" does not exist in EGO's catalog. EGO's actual current 10 in. pole saw attachment for the Multi-Head/Power Head system is the PSA1000 (Oregon bar/chain, 38 in. attachment shaft, automatic oiler, tool-less chain tensioning), confirmed on EGO's own operator's manual (manualslib-hosted PDF) and cross-listed identically on Amazon, Lowe's, and Acme Tools. Chain speed (15 m/s), guide bar length (250mm/10 in.), chain pitch (9.5mm/3/8 in.), oil tank capacity (220ml/7.4 fl oz), and weight (1.89kg/4.17 lb) are from EGO's official PSA1000 operator's manual. maxReachFt (3.2 ft / 38 in.) reflects the attachment's own shaft length only — total system reach depends on the EGO Power Head's separate shaft, which is not published as a combined figure, so max cutting diameter is left null rather than guessed.

products.name: Ryobi RY40561 40V Attachment-Capable 10 in. Pole Saw
products.priceNote: Current Home Depot retail (kit w/ 2.6Ah battery & charger); Struggleville reported a prior sale price of $150.
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model number "RY40563" does not correspond to any Ryobi product across Ryobi's own site, Home Depot, or major retailers. The closest and current real Ryobi 40V pole saw with Expand-It attachment capability is the RY40561, confirmed on Ryobi's official support/product page and corroborated on Toolstash (10 in. bar, 9.5-12 ft. adjustable reach, 8 in. max cutting diameter, 3/8 in. pitch, 14 lb, automatic oiler). No chain speed or oil tank capacity figure is published on any fetched source, so both are left null.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 2825-21PS 10 in. Pole Saw Kit w/ QUIK-LOK
products.priceNote: Representative current dealer price (redtoolstore.com/J Harlen Co range); Hanes Supply lists $481.90. Milwaukee restricts MAP pricing at some online retailers (price shown only in cart).

specs.powerSource: M18 18V Li-ion (REDLITHIUM HIGH OUTPUT XC8.0 battery & M18/M12 rapid charger included)

products.provenance: Milwaukee's official product page confirms POWERSTATE brushless motor, REDLINK PLUS overload protection, 10 in. Oregon bar/chain, 0.043 in. gauge / 3/8 in. low-profile pitch, 80 in. overall QUIK-LOK pole+head length, and 12.7 lb weight; up to 150 cuts per charge. The 80 in. figure is the fixed (non-telescoping) tool length rather than an adjustable reach spec — Milwaukee sells a separate 3 ft. attachment extension for additional reach — so maxReachFt (6.7 ft = 80 in.) reflects the as-built tool length, noted here rather than presented as a telescoping max. No chain speed or oil tank capacity figure is published, so both are left null.

products.name: Sun Joe SWJ800E 8 in. 6.5-Amp Electric Telescoping Pole Saw
products.provenance: Ace Hardware's listing (reproducing Sun Joe's own spec sheet) confirms 6.5A/120V motor, 8 in. Oregon bar/chain, telescoping shaft from 5.6 ft. to 8.7 ft. for up to 15 ft. total reach, 7.5 in. max cutting thickness, 2 fl oz (60ml) oil tank, auto-oiler, and 7.5 lb net weight; a separate manufacturer PDF manual independently confirms the 3/8 in. chain pitch (shared across the SWJ800E/SWJ802E/iON8PS family). One secondary retailer listing cited a slightly different 7.7 lb net weight; 7.5 lb (Ace Hardware, matching the primary spec sheet) is used as the corroborated figure.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER LPP120 20V MAX POWERCONNECT Cordless Pole Pruning Saw
products.priceNote: AutoZone current retail (kit with battery/charger). A bare-tool variant (LPP120B) is also sold without battery/charger.

specs.powerSource: 20V MAX Li-ion (1.5Ah battery & charger included on the LPP120 kit)

products.provenance: Black+Decker's own product page confirms 8 in. bar/chain, 6 in. max cutting diameter, a center pole extension giving 6.5 ft. or 10 ft. usable length (up to 14 ft. overhead reach), 20V MAX 1.5Ah battery good for ~100 cuts per charge, and 10.3 lb weight. A secondary industrial-supply listing (RSHughes) cited a conflicting 6.3 lb figure, likely referencing the powerhead alone without pole/battery; the manufacturer's own 10.3 lb full-unit figure is used as the corroborated value. Lubrication is manual (oil bottle included, no automatic oiler or published tank capacity) and no chain pitch figure was found on any fetched source, so oilTankCapacityFlOz and chainPitchIn are left null.

products.name: Husqvarna 525PT5S 12 in. 25.4cc 2-Cycle Professional Gas Pole Saw
products.priceNote: Representative dealer price (sawsuppliers.com); Husqvarna sells only through its dealer network and does not publish a fixed consumer MSRP, so street price varies by dealer.
products.provenance: Husqvarna's own product page confirms the 25.4cc X-Torq engine (1.36 hp), telescopic shaft adjustable up to 16 ft. cutting height, 12 in. bar, H35 chain, 17.25 fl oz fuel tank, 0.3 US pint (4.8 fl oz) oil tank, LowVib anti-vibration, and 15.4 lb weight excluding cutting equipment. Chain pitch is documented by Husqvarna only as chain model "H35" rather than a stated pitch fraction, so chainPitchIn is left null rather than inferred. No published max cutting diameter figure was found, so it is left null.

specs.powerSource: 40V MAX Li-ion (B600E 4.0Ah battery & C600 charger included in this kit)

No oil tank capacity or max cutting diameter figure was found, so both are left null.

products.name: Ryobi RY43160A 8 in. 6-Amp Electric Pole Saw
products.priceNote: Ryobi official site price; other retailers cited around $150.
products.provenance: Ryobi's official product page and corroborating parts listings (eReplacementParts, PartSelect) confirm the 6 Amp corded electric motor, 8 in. bar and chain, adjustable pole length up to 9 ft., angled in-line motor head for precision pruning, and a max cutting diameter of 6 in.; 3-year warranty. The seed listed this as "RY43160" — the current-production SKU sold at retail is RY43160A (same tool, updated suffix); both designators are used interchangeably across Ryobi's own parts documentation, and the entry is kept under the retail-current RY43160A designation. No chain speed, oil tank capacity, chain pitch, or weight figure was found on any fetched source, so all four are left null.
